changes: Kidsy: Android phone/TV uses existing Media3 with bounded 8MB live buffering; verified actual H264 frames on emulator and release on exit. HTML player detects audio-only startup and tries its existing HLS fallback. Samsung native video clears every artwork layer.

Fix external Android app launches: preserve NEW_TASK and RESET_TASK_IF_NEEDED and use startActivity, so task-root splash checks can reach the main screen. Oscar TV report not yet verified on physical TCL.
Native IPTV multi-view on Android TV/Google TV and Android phone: up to four independent players, 2x2/two/large+three layouts, one audio source or mute all; channel chooser uses current subscription.

On Android emulator: four local test videos actually rendered, channel chooser, selected audio/mute, hidden-player release and exit cleanup verified. Physical TVs/provider concurrency remain unverified.
Remove Morph Sports section, dock shortcut and unused Sports artwork from packages; remove public Sports backend routes.
Fitness sidebar shortcut defaults hidden; optional toggle in existing Home and apps settings category, preserving workout history and Plus behavior.
Light preset keeps icon/focus animations on while blur and shadows remain off. Independent motion-off switch is retained.
Theme-aware curved/striped dock focus uses the sidebar visual language. Radio and HDMI use matching glass shells with distinct glyph colors.
Multi-view is hidden on Samsung/LG; this release does not claim four-stream playback on these platforms.
Remove redundant Back to Settings buttons; remote Back returns to settings categories.

Fix World clubs mixed-pack routing: Madrid/Barcelona stay free, Miami assets use the authenticated Plus endpoint. Verify and reuse older cached images and legacy Miami packs; repair only missing/corrupt assets.
Three bundled free Islamic themes in their own category on TV and phone: Makkah, Madinah and Jerusalem. Supplied images converted to WebP with full-frame fit and CSS gradient blending.
